project_type: Node.js Express REST API server with PostgreSQL database
test_framework: Jest with supertest for API testing
verification_instructions: Run npm test to execute Jest test suites. For manual testing, start the dev server with npm run dev and ensure database is running with npm run db:up
environment_constraints: Requires PostgreSQL database running (Docker Compose available via npm run db:up). Database schema is defined in /home/yatnam/Desktop/Thomas/koottam/server/database/init.sql
contribution_requirements: All new API endpoints must follow existing patterns: use asyncHandler wrapper, AppError for errors, successResponse for responses, protect middleware for authenticated routes, and parameterized SQL queries to prevent injection
key_patterns: Controllers use asyncHandler, throw AppError for errors, return successResponse. Services handle database logic with transactions for multi-step operations. Routes use Express Router with protect middleware for auth. Database queries use pool.query with parameterized statements ($1, $2, etc.). Response format: {success: true/false, message: string, data: object}. All UUIDs, timestamps handled by PostgreSQL
directory_structure: src/ contains: app.js (Express app setup), index.js (server entry), config/ (db.js, env.js), controllers/ (request handlers), services/ (business logic), routes/ (Express routers), middleware/ (auth.js, errorHandler.js, rateLimiter.js), utils/ (asyncHandler.js, AppError.js, response.js), test/ (Jest test files). Database schema in database/init.sql
